one_month_reasoning: The window runs to 2026-11-05 and the Q3 2026 print almost certainly falls inside it. Alphabet has not announced the date yet: EDGAR shows no 8-K since Aug 10, and S&P Global estimates Oct 28. Alphabet has reported Q3 in the last week of October in recent years, and the window now runs past Nov 1, so I put about 97% on the print landing inside it. My read of the Q2 call for what to watch: the CFO said Q3 'will begin lapping an acceleration in Search performance', that there will be a slight FX headwind, and that renting third-party capacity will create 'modest margin pressure' in Cloud. Against that, Cloud has a $514B backlog and FY27 consensus EPS has risen to $15.10, so the bar is moving up. Management said 2027 capex will 'increase significantly', with details 'at a later date'. If a number comes with Q3, it is the main swing factor; the standing capex view's base case implies roughly $290-300B. The MSFT, META and AMZN prints the same week will also set the capex tone. Nothing since Oct 2 changes this. The Constellation deal (Oct 6) is a long-dated power PPA with no disclosed cost, and the stock moved +1.2% Oct 2-6, in line with QQQ (+1.3%). I expect a two-sided move and no directional call. I use a mixture centred at about $349 (+0.4% drift): monthly sigma 8.5% at 75% weight and 13% at 25%. The effective sigma of about 9.7% is a little above the stock's usual 9.1% because of the print.

fair_value.method: 60% P/E plus 40% SOTP. The P/E leg is 21x core on CY2028E EPS of $17.0 (= $357), plus about $15/share of after-tax net financial assets, for $372. The SOTP leg is $348. The blend is about $362, against $361 on 2026-10-02.

methods.name: P/E
methods.inputs: At Oct 2027 the market prices CY2028 EPS. Consensus CY2028 EPS is $17.89 (MarketScreener); I trim about 5% for 2027-capex D&A and use $17.0. The core multiple is 21x: inside the 10-peer range of 8.6-33.7x, about 7% above the peer median of 19.6x and below the mega-cap median of 24.4x. That gives $357, plus about $15/share of after-tax net financial assets (cash net of debt, SpaceX, non-marketable book) that consensus EPS does not capture. Total about $372.

$17.89 x 0.95. I haircut about 5% for depreciation on 2027 capex. The standing view's Big-4 base is +47% in 2027 ($733B to $1,080B). Applied to Alphabet's $200B 2026 midpoint, that gives about $295B, which the CFO calls a 'significant' increase. At the call's 60% servers / 40% DC mix, that adds about $35-40B a year of run-rate D&A from 2028. I cannot verify how much of it consensus already carries. Equivalent to +12.6% on the $15.10 CY2027 consensus.

Peer CY2027 P/E: median 19.6x, range 8.6-33.7x across 10 names; mega-cap four median 24.4x. GOOGL today is 23.0x all-in, or (347.68-15)/15.10 = 22.0x core. Visibility comes from contract, not forecast: $513.9B of Cloud backlog, just over half recognisable within 24 months (10-Q). Margins are top-quartile (Services 41.8%, Cloud 35.6%). I stay below today's 22x because FCF is negative (Q2 -$5.9B), buybacks are zero (10-Q), and capex rises significantly in 2027. methods.name: SOTP
methods.inputs: Services: 2027E OI $175B x (1-18%) x 20 = $2.87T. Cloud: 2027E revenue $150B x 7 = $1.05T. Other Bets/Waymo: $0.15T. Alphabet-level AI costs: -$23.2B x 0.82 x 20 = -$0.38T. Net financial assets: $0.24T, i.e. cash net of debt $40B + other equity $7B + SpaceX $94.1B x 0.85 + non-marketable $131.5B x 0.85. Total $3.93T / 12.30B = $319 today; rolled forward 9% to $348.

inputs_detail.derivation: Q2 annualised is $158B. I add about 11% growth, below the reported +19.6% y/y because Q3 laps a Search acceleration and D&A and energy costs rise (CFO, Q2 call).

Recognising just over 50% of $513.9B over 24 months gives about $130B a year from backlog alone. Add new bookings and TPU system sales, the 'vast majority' of which the CFO says land in 2027.

At a 35% OI margin and 18% tax this is about 24x after-tax OI. That is in line with the faster-growing peers (NOW 27.6x, MSFT 24.4x, AMZN 24.5x CY2027 P/E). Cloud is growing at 82%. bear.story: The Q3 or Q4 print guides 2027 capex near $370B (the standing view's Big-4 high case of +86% y/y, applied to Alphabet's $200B 2026 midpoint). FCF stays negative and the market treats the 2026 equity, convert and $25B debt raises as overreach. Search growth slows from 17% to single digits as Q3 laps the 2025 acceleration and AI answers cannibalise clicks, and the DC Circuit tightens the Search remedies. The stock trades at about 15x core on $15 of CY2027 EPS plus reduced stake value.

base.story: Cloud converts its backlog (2027 revenue about $150B at 30%+ margins) and Services grows low double digits. D&A from about $295B of 2027 capex holds CY2028 EPS growth to about 12-13% ($17.0). The stock trades at 21x core plus about $15/share of stakes.

bull.story: TPU system sales land in 2027 as guided, Gemini 4 broadens from the Fairwind preview to GA and monetises across Search, the Gemini app and Cloud, and consensus CY2028 of $17.89 proves too low (about $19). The stock re-rates to about 24x core, the mega-cap median, plus stake re-marks. The capped calls limit convert dilution up to about $530.

comps_summary.peer_range: CY2027 P/E 8.6x (ADBE) to 33.7x (AAPL); EV/CY2027 EBITDA 6.8x (ADBE) to 26.0x (AAPL); CY2027 EPS growth -4% (CRM) to +26% (AMZN, RDDT). comps_summary.our_multiple_vs_peers: 21x core on CY2028E. That is inside the range, about 7% above the 10-peer median and about 14% below the mega-cap median. The SOTP Services leg uses 20x after tax, about at the median.
comps_summary.premium_discount_justification: The small premium rests on growth and margin evidence that persists through Oct 2027, not on sell-side calls. (1) CY2027 consensus EPS growth is +27%, against a peer median of +15%. (2) Growth visibility is contractual: Cloud backlog is $513.9B with just over half recognisable within 24 months (10-Q), more than 4x trailing Cloud revenue. (3) Margins: Services 41.8%, Cloud 35.6% (8-K). I take only about 7% over the median, not the growth-proportional premium, because FCF is negative, buybacks are suspended, 2027 capex rises significantly, and the Search remedies appeal is open. Basis and method: one consistent basis for every name. P/E is the Oct 6 close over calendar-2027 S&P Global consensus EPS. Non-December fiscal years are time-weighted: MSFT 50/50 FY27/FY28; ORCL 5/12 FY27 + 7/12 FY28; AAPL 75% FY27 + 25% FY28, where FY28 is MarketScreener's figure; CRM FY Jan-2028; ADBE FY Nov-2027. EV/EBITDA is the S&P Global EV over MarketScreener CY2027 EBITDA. For CRM I took MarketScreener's '2027' column, so the fiscal-year mapping is approximate. Excluded: NVDA and AVGO (semiconductor cyclicality); Tencent, Alibaba and Baidu (China regulatory and FX discount); TTD (EV about $4.6B, EPS falling, not a comparable scale or quality). [citation gate 2026-10-06: peer P/Es here use S&P Global adjusted EPS via Stock Analysis (aggregator, ex-SBC) and some FY28 inputs are paywalled; they are not on GOOGL's GAAP basis and are not used in any supervisor number. thesis_break_reason: $255 is about 15.9x CY2027 consensus core EPS ($15.10, after about $15/share of after-tax stakes and net cash), below the 19.6x peer median and roughly at the cheapest non-de-rated peers (ORCL 14.8x, RDDT 15.4x). It is about 8% above the 52-week low of $235.84. At that level the market would be saying either that consensus is being cut (Search breaking under AI substitution or an adverse appellate ruling on default payments), or that the $513.9B Cloud backlog is not converting at margins near Q2's 35.6%. A capex guide alone, even at the high end, should take the stock to the high-$200s, not $255. Unchanged from 2026-10-02: the consensus rise (+1.8%) is too small to move it.

reasoning: Delta refresh of my 2026-10-02 file. I re-checked filings first. EDGAR shows no 8-K, 10-Q or proxy since Aug 10; the only new filing is an Oct 2 Form 4. So I re-opened and confirmed every reported figure that feeds my fair value at source: the Q2 8-K, the 10-Q, the Q2 call transcript, and the June 5 and Aug 10 8-Ks. The only company releases are the Oct 6 Constellation PPA (890 MW of uprates, 20 years; a separate 2,700 MW, 15-year supply deal; first uprate 2028; cost undisclosed) and the Sep 30/Oct 1 Gemini 4 Argon preview (Fairwind-only, no GA date). Neither changes a 12-month number. Neither does the stock's move: +1.2% Oct 2-6, in line with QQQ's +1.3%. What did change is consensus. CY2027 EPS is now $15.10 (S&P Global; 24/7 Wall St shows $14.47 to $15.10 in 90 days), against $14.84 in my last file. MarketScreener carries CY2028 at $17.89. I also built the 10-peer comp set my prior file lacked, on one CY2027 basis. Its median is 19.6x P/E and 11.9x EV/EBITDA; GOOGL is at 23.0x all-in and 22.0x core. I now apply 21x core, down from 21.5x and anchored to that peer set, to CY2028E EPS of $17.0 (consensus less about 5% for 2027-capex D&A, sized from the standing capex view: Big-4 2027 base +47%), up from $16.5. With about $15/share of stakes, the P/E leg is $372. The SOTP is unchanged at $348. The blend is $362, against $361. The ladder uses median ≈ fair value $362 (+4%), a fat-tailed lognormal mixture (27% sigma at 70%, 40% at 30%, about 31% effective vs 32% realised), and P(≥ spot) of 0.55. The scenario mean is $368 (22/53/25 at $245/$368/$475), consistent with right skew. Thesis break stays $255. For one month, the Q3 print is about 97% inside the window, two-sided, centred at about $349. Lane: 9 of the 15 non-comp sources are primary (60%). The 30 data pages behind the comp table (3 per peer, required by the 2026-10-03 peer rule) are not counted. No option data was used.
